notes: The booklet is low-resolution and several steps are ambiguous, so many placements are estimates. I put the long axis left-right with the nose at the left, and counted from the base plate p15.

Fixes from the last check: the studs of p19 (4 x 4 sloped brick with 4 x 2 recess) are on its two outer rows, and its studs top out at 2.5 plates above its bottom (layer 2.5). Bricks p3 and p2 now sit on those outer rows, front and back. Bricks p13 and p12 sit on p3 and p2. Plates p4 and p5 sit on p13 and p12, so each rests_on now matches its placement.

The clear studs p32 and p33 now sit on the free front studs of plate p6, added at step 6 before the wedge p21. The wedge plate p21 is shifted left and clutches only the front column of studs on p20, so it no longer overlaps p19. Its layer is 2.5 above p20.

The wheels and tyres are placed outside the wheel-holder pins. Each wheel is joined to its holder, and each tyre to its wheel, in other_joins. A tyre necessarily surrounds its wheel, so that overlap is real and intended. The wheel and tyre have no studs, so rests_on is empty. I left about 0.7 stud between the holder's pin tip and the wheel's inner face, so the box of the holder does not overlap the wheel.

The ladder plate p16 is placed under the front end of p6, with its studs going up into p6's underside. The ladder hangs down the front as the grille. p16 is added at step 6, after p6, so it is not listed under rests_on. It is joined to p6 in other_joins.

Steps 1 and 2 are hard to read. I read the base as plate p15 with plate p7 at the rear end, then black brick p1 on it. The front yellow plate p6 hangs two studs past the front of p15 and clutches it at the front stud column.
The clear plate p11 with yellow plate p10 on top is built in the step 10 inset. I counted it as step 10 rather than a separate step.
The red studs p30 and p31 sit on the top plate p5. Their exact stud positions are estimates.
